{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load and deduplicate data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')
data = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Replace sentinel values in baseline
data['biomarker_baseline'] = data['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute change
data['biomarker_change'] = data['biomarker_final'] - data['biomarker_baseline']

# Filter to non-missing baseline and final
valid_data = data.dropna(subset=['biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final'])

# Compute average change by arm
mean_change_by_arm = valid_data.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()
print("Mean biomarker change by arm:")
print(mean_change_by_arm)

# Check severity distribution by arm
severity_by_arm = pd.crosstab(valid_data['arm'], valid_data['severity'])
print("\nSeverity by arm (valid data):")
print(severity_by_arm)

# Compute response rates by arm, stratified by severity
response_by_arm_severity = valid_data.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(level='severity')
print("\nResponse rate by arm and severity:")
print(response_by_arm_severity)

# Compute overall response rates by arm
overall_response_by_arm = valid_data.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print("\nOverall response rate by arm (valid data):")
print(overall_response_by_arm)"}
